identificationModule.briefTitle: ARX788 in HER2-positive Metastatic Breast Cancer Patients Who Were Previously Treated With T-DXd
identificationModule.officialTitle: Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of ARX788 in Patients With HER2-positive Advanced Breast Cancer Whose Disease Has Progressed Following T-DXd Therapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A single arm, phase 2 Study of ARX788 in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients who were previously treated with T-DXd. The ARX788 will be administered every 3 weeks (Q3W) intravenous (IV) infusion.

armGroups.label: ARX788
armGroups.description: ARX788，1.5 mg/kg IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day treatment cycle
